name: Merchant battery storage in Greece: the rules of the call for a Final Connection Offer
description: Capacity caps, competent operator, deadline, technical requirements, financial capability, letters of guarantee, readiness declaration and concentration limits of ministerial decision ΥΠΕΝ/ΓΔΕ/28255/1143/2025 for standalone battery storage, each with its provision.
creator: Ariadne Labs

rows.What: Total cap on Final Connection Offers
rows.Rule: 3,800 MW of maximum injection capacity from ΑΔΜΗΕ and 900 MW from ΔΕΔΔΗΕ
ΔΕΔΔΗΕ for stations up to and including 10 MW, ΑΔΜΗΕ for larger ones
rows.Provision: same decision, art. 2(1), as amended by Β΄ 5165/2025
same decision, art. 3(2), as amended by Β΄ 5165/2025

rows.Rule: batteries only; injection capacity of at least 0.5 MW; usable capacity of at least two hours; round-trip efficiency of at least 80%
a loan pre-approval or own funds for the whole cost, at a reference cost of EUR 200 per kWh of guaranteed capacity; letters of intent are not accepted
rows.Provision: same decision, art. 3(1) and (2), as amended by Β΄ 5165/2025

rows.Rule: EUR 200,000 per MW above 10 MW, EUR 50,000 per MW up to 10 MW (EUR 100,000 per MW without financing evidence), valid for at least two years
rows.Provision: same decision, art. 3(2)(ιγ), as amended by Β΄ 5165/2025

rows.Rule: EUR 200,000 per MW above 10 MW, EUR 50,000 per MW up to 10 MW; halved after three years of operation and returned after six
rows.Provision: same decision, art. 7(2), as amended by Β΄ 5165/2025

rows.Rule: within 18 months of accepting the Final Connection Offer
250 MW per natural or legal person with its connected companies, 50 MW on the distribution network, and 500 MW in total of batteries until the end of 2029
rows.Provision: same decision, art. 5, as amended by Β΄ 5165/2025

rows.Rule: none: the stations receive no operating support and do not take part in support tenders
